THE KADRION ENGINE

One closed-loop GPU pipeline from raw footage to winning variants

Ad dashboards tell you that an ad stopped converting — never which frame, cut, or vocal cadence lost the viewer. Kadrion ties live ad telemetry straight to GPU-accelerated video synthesis.

01

Frame-Level Multimodal Diagnostics

Decodes raw footage and syncs Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Ads metrics to score 0–3s visual hooks, shot pacing, caption legibility, and vocal prosody.

02

GPU-Accelerated Variant Synthesis

Automatically re-cuts top-performing scenes, smart-reframes across 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 aspect ratios, swaps opening hooks, and localizes captions in batch.

03

Closed-Loop Creative Ranking

Feeds live thumbstop rate, CTR, and CPA back into brand-specific LoRA ranking models so every new batch launches smarter than the last.

INFRASTRUCTURE & AI STACK

Engineered natively on NVIDIA SDKs and AWS GPU clusters

Zero CPU decode bottlenecks and zero third-party wrapper markups. Select any stage below to inspect the exact NVIDIA runtime and AWS deployment layer.

Zero-Copy Video Ingest & Optical Reframing

EC2 G6 (NVIDIA L4)

Raw 4K/1080p ad footage streams from Amazon S3 straight into GPU memory via NVIDIA Video Codec SDK (NVDEC). CV-CUDA runs optical-flow shot boundary detection and subject-aware smart cropping without CPU round-trips.

NVIDIA Technology
NVDEC, CV-CUDA, Optical Flow SDK
AWS Infrastructure
Amazon EC2 G6 (L4), Amazon S3, Amazon SQS
PIPELINE CONFIGURATION
pipeline.ingest(source="s3://kadrion-raw/campaign_42.mp4")
  .decode(codec="nvdec_h264", zero_copy=True)
  .segment(sdk="cv_cuda.optical_flow", threshold=0.38)
  .reframe(targets=["9:16", "4:5", "1:1"], track="salient_subject")

Common questions

No. Synthetic text-to-video often hallucinates brand packaging and violates ad policies. Kadrion works directly with your real UGC, studio shoots, and product footage — diagnosing hook retention and GPU-rendering authentic, brand-compliant variants.
